integrity: All move counts, orbit claims, and target isomorphisms are exhaustively replayed from the explicit facet list by a standalone exact finite checker. Polytopality of the 18-tetrahedron target uses the published complete eight-vertex sphere classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the one-move vertex-nonincreasing bistellar neighborhood of the fixed eight-vertex Barnette sphere. It does not determine longer bistellar distances or analogous multiplicities for the other eight-vertex spheres.
title: The complete vertex-nonincreasing bistellar neighborhood of Barnette's eight-vertex sphere
